subject: Thanks for the ride
text: Hey, thanks again for stepping in yesterday. I know the event start was tight, and you still helped me sort the parking pass situation. I would have been standing there confused for hours. It made a real difference, and I did not want that to go unmentioned. I also realized my ride request might have come through too late. Next time, I will ask earlier. Let me know if you need anything for Saturday. Also, if the entrance line is bad, maybe let me handle it.
